context: Checks that existing verification graphs, proof validity and consumer/platform boundaries survive a targeted frontend change.

checklist.name: preserves_owner_graph
checklist.description: Keeps the documented lanes and does not create a replacement verify wrapper or collapse separate package/device checks into every default run.

checklist.name: reuses_valid_proof
checklist.description: Reuses the passing web and browser evidence for unchanged web-only source and environment; a new turn or completed handoff alone does not trigger another run.

checklist.name: checks_affected_consumers
checklist.description: For shared UI behavior, includes both web and TV dependent lanes and installed tarball verification, retaining separate browser and remote interaction acceptance.

checklist.name: honors_invalidation_and_full_gate
checklist.description: After a root lockfile change, runs the owner-mandated full gate and refreshes affected runtime/package proof instead of reusing invalidated results; uncertainty also retains the full gate.

checklist.name: reports_proof_and_authority_limits
checklist.description: Separates executed/reused proof from unavailable TV acceptance, names the missing device flow, and does not claim browser checks prove remote behavior or infer permission for live writes, deployment or paid evaluation.
